title: Not All the Blood of Beasts
description: Not All the Blood of Beasts in Tonic Solfa to BOYLSTON, doh is C: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 5 verses and a piano.
about: Isaac Watts wrote these words for his Hymns and Spiritual Songs (1707), Book II, composed on divine subjects, hymn 142, headed “Faith in Christ our sacrifice”.
Watts' hymns were printed without tunes and sung to any tune of their metre, Short Metre (6.6.8.6). This page sets the words to BOYLSTON; any other Short Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: Not all the blood of beasts On Jew-ish al-tars slain Could give the guilt-y con-science peace, Or wash a-way the stain.

lines: Not all the blood of beasts
Could give the guilty conscience peace,
My faith would lay her hand
On that dear head of thine,
While like a penitent I stand
My soul looks back to see
When hanging on the cursed tree,
And hopes her guilt was there.
We bless the Lamb with cheerful voice,

source: Isaac Watts, Hymns and Spiritual Songs (1707)
licence: Public domain: Isaac Watts died in 1748.
credits: Words by Isaac Watts (1674–1748), public domain; set to BOYLSTON by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
